summary: Limits channel values to a range and can quantize channel values or indices for stepped/sample-and-hold behavior.
key_concepts: Limits input channel values to a minimum and maximum range using off, clamp, loop, or zigzag modes.
Clamp saturates values to the range, while Loop wraps and Zigzag mirrors values back through the interval.
Positive Only takes the absolute value of channels before other range handling.
Normalize scales and offsets channels into the -1 to 1 range, but it does not work with Time Slicing enabled.
Value quantization snaps samples to floor, ceiling, or rounded value steps with an optional offset.
Index quantization acts like time quantization or sample-and-hold, sampling at quantized indices and holding between them.

key_params.name: type
key_params.note: Off, clamp, loop, or zigzag limiting mode

key_params.name: positive
key_params.note: Make values positive only by taking absolute value

key_params.name: relstart
key_params.note: Quantize index relative to CHOP start

common_gotchas: Clamp cuts values to min/max, while Loop wraps and Zigzag mirrors values back into range.
Maximum is treated as the upper range boundary, so loop-style behavior may remain less than Max.
Normalize does not work with Time Slicing enabled.
Index quantization acts like sample-and-hold over time and can intentionally flatten fast changes.
Quantization by Floor/Ceiling/Round changes value semantics; use Math CHOP if arithmetic mapping is needed instead.
